checked_scenarios: Animated Scramble reordering keeps scene sections as stable view identities; action closures reject stale boards and retain slot-based accessibility labels.
Memory card fades preserve face-down privacy in the accessibility tree and do not change matched-pair, score or bonus state.
Game, replay and summary transitions update saved state immediately; animation completion never controls progress or enables input.
Reduce Motion disables explicit action, navigation, card and press-scale animations; the result symbol no longer bounces.
Outgoing round views remain subject to model guards and existing analytics deduplication during brief fades.
residual_risks: Physical-device motion comfort and VoiceOver user evaluation remain untested.
verified_in_recording: Stable Memory card faces crossfade through intermediate frames.
Scramble scene sections move between positions over a brief interval.
